target.title: fix: cap Codex native tool output before replay
target.body:
Closes #99465
Related: #99551

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where oversized native Codex tool output could remain large enough in OpenClaw's Codex app-server projection surfaces to dominate replay-bound worker context even though visible transcript rendering had a separate truncation path.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds one shared projector-side cap for native Codex tool output and routes snapshot command output, streamed command-output fallback text, dynamic/MCP projected output text, trajectory `tool.result` output, transcript tool-result messages, and emitted tool-result progress text through it. The cap is `10_000` characters including the truncation notice, and the notice includes the original character count plus the displayed cap.

The change does not claim to fix every future token runaway. It hardens the app-server projection boundary that was still allowing large output text to stay live after a small worker task produced repeated verbose tool results.

## User Impact

Operators and users should see oversized native tool output summarized with an explicit OpenClaw truncation notice instead of having very large command output copied into replay-bound Codex/OpenClaw projection surfaces. This reduces the chance that one verbose command result dominates later worker input tokens.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.test.ts`
  - 101 tests passed.
- `git diff --check`
  - Passed.

Additional local proof attempt:

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/run-attempt.test.ts`
  - 115 tests passed.
  - 1 existing unrelated test timed out locally: `keeps managed web_search for provider-qualified Codex model overrides`.
- Targeted rerun of that single web-search override test stayed silent for about one minute and was interrupted for local resource safety.

Notes:

- No raw private worker transcript or session JSONL content is included in this PR.
- GitHub CI/Testbox should be treated as the broader integration proof for the `run-attempt` lane.
- AI-assisted change.

## Mergeability Proof Update (2026-07-04)

Redacted behavior proof for ClawSweeper, from PR head `35756ae97fa71e0f76cf267893e73804614cf67c`:

- Fixed ClawSweeper P3: streamed output continues counting after the replay/display buffer is capped via a per-item original-length counter.
- Fixed current P2 review: streamed output accumulation now appends only the bounded visible prefix and never builds `current + delta` after the cap.
- Fixed current P2 review: streamed command output now registers bounded echo text and a long raw-prefix echo key, so a later raw assistant item containing the full streamed shell output is not promoted into `assistantTexts` or replay-bound assistant messages.
- Regression proof: `caps streamed command output used for replay when snapshots omit aggregated output` streams `12_345 + 678 = 13_023` chars, asserts the replay-bound output is exactly `10_000` chars, asserts the truncation notice says `original 13023 chars`, and asserts the truncation notice appears exactly once.
- Regression proof: `does not promote raw streamed full-output echoes after replay truncation` streams a 12,367-char shell output, simulates a raw assistant echo of that full output, asserts no assistant text is promoted, and asserts the tool-result replay stays capped at `10_000` chars without the tail sentinel.
- Focused validation run after the P2/P3 fixes: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.test.ts` passed, 104 tests.
- Focused validation run after the P2/P3 fixes: `git diff --check && node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.test.ts` passed.
- Scope boundary: this is projector-side replay/projection hardening; no raw private worker transcript or session JSONL content is included.



## Mergeability Proof Update (2026-07-04, head 71b4d6c3a9)

- Fixed current P2 review: user-controlled output containing the OpenClaw truncation notice marker no longer corrupts later replay-bound truncation. Streaming append now tracks projector-owned raw prefix state separately from user text. Regression: `does not parse user output as a prior truncation notice when streaming crosses the cap`.
- Fixed current P2 review: streamed raw-output echo suppression is now bounded per native tool item via `toolProgressEchoesByItem` instead of accumulating every cumulative output snapshot. Regression: `bounds streamed output echo signatures per tool item`.
- Fixed current P2 review: final assistant answers are no longer suppressed merely because they start with a long tool-output prefix. Echo filtering now requires exact emitted display text or matching original raw length plus recorded raw prefix. Regression: `keeps final answers that only start with a streamed tool-output prefix`.
- Focused validation after these fixes: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.test.ts` passed, 107 tests.
- Focused validation after these fixes: `git diff --check && node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.test.ts` passed.



## Mergeability Proof Update (2026-07-04, head 67d2cc2542)

- Fixed current P2 review: streamed raw-output echo signatures now store normalized trimmed raw length, matching the normalized assistant raw text used by `isToolProgressEchoText`. Regression: `normalizes streamed raw echo lengths before comparing assistant echoes`.
- Focused validation after this fix: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.test.ts` passed, 108 tests.
- Focused validation after this fix: `git diff --check && node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.test.ts` passed.



## Mergeability Proof Update (2026-07-04, head 7a82560e0b)

- Fixed current P2 review: snapshot-only command aggregates now record a trimmed raw echo signature before transcript truncation, so full raw aggregate echoes from the active turn are suppressed while replay-visible output stays capped. Regression: `preserves raw aggregate echo signatures before snapshot output truncation`.
- Focused validation after this fix: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.test.ts` passed, 109 tests.
- Focused validation after this fix: `git diff --check && node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.test.ts` passed.
- The prior red `QA Smoke CI` was the unrelated `native-command-session-target` timeout; direct rerun requires repo-admin rights, so the branch was advanced with a no-op CI retrigger commit before this review fix.
